caption: The drawing shows a single object, a lidded jug or tankard with a handle, displayed against a plain, light background. The jug has a bulbous body with a narrow neck and a flat, hinged lid topped by a spherical finial. The jug features a combination of blue and grayish-tan colors; the handle, base, neck, and lid are depicted in a metallic gray tone. The central part of the jug is decorated with a deep blue background, adorned with an ornate, scrolling floral pattern in a pale beige or cream color. A vertical band runs from beneath the neck to the base, consisting of circular medallions in the same grayish-tan color as the lid, base, and handle. Fine lines of blue and tan accentuate the edges of the jug, emphasizing its contours and structural details. The entire composition presents only this single jug, with no other objects or background elements present.
title: Three Quart Beer Pitcher
